verdict.rationale: Honeycomb has no documented native feature that produces AI-generated incident or alert summaries. Instead, its official MCP server and agent-skills plugin let an external AI agent query live telemetry and investigate latency or error spikes, which could be used to build such summaries. Alert webhooks carry templated alert-context variables, but nothing in them is AI-generated. missing for 10: native AI-generated incident summaries, AI-enriched alert context delivered to responders in triggers or notifications, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
